title: Scalar mate compatibility with derived reduction and pullback counits
statement: For a prime ℓ, normed field E over ℚ_ℓ and scheme map f:X→Y, let P be any integral homotopy complex on Y, with the functors of [new-integral-residue-pull-square-data]. Derived reduction of the integral pullback counit followed by the X reduction counit and Qh of the ordinary scalar pull comparison equals the derived scalar pull mate at Qh P followed by residue pullback of the Y reduction counit and the residue pullback counit. No flatness hypothesis on P or f is assumed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; derived mate comparison after the flatness clause

proof.text: The derived reduction adjunction unit followed by exact restriction of the reduction counit and the restriction localization factor is Qh of the ordinary scalar-extension unit. This follows from derivedη_fac_app, transported across the exact right-derived-functor comparison.

Transpose the desired equality along reduction on X and postcompose by the invertible exact restriction localization factor. The mate unit equation and naturality move the two units and counits into their ordinary homotopy form. Use the exact restriction/pullback factorization to identify the second transpose; the first transpose follows from naturality of the restriction factor.

The remaining equality is naturality of the integral pullback counit applied to the ordinary scalar-unit square. Apply residueExchangePull_ordinary_unit. Cancel the exact restriction factor and use injectivity of the reduction adjunction hom-equivalence.

theorem scalar_mate_counit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).map
        ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).app P) ≫
      (residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E X).app
          ((((f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
          (pullIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f).hom (.up ℤ)).app P) =
    (residueExchangePullHom ℓ E f).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ≫
      (residueExchangeUpperStar
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).map
          ((residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E Y).app P) ≫
      ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).app
          (((Mod.extendScalars
            (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapHomotopyCategory
              (.up ℤ)).obj P))
